summary: Iteration 2: full backend + frontend E2E testing of new features (Activities accordion + editable subgroups, Visit Us map/hours, Ashrama carousel, Gallery categories). Backend pytest: 24/24 passing (7 new tests added for activities CRUD/auth and gallery category default+filter+persistence). Frontend: Home shows all new sections (activities, activities-accordion, visit, visit-map, visit-hours, ashrama-carousel). Navbar Lenis smooth-scroll works (Our Activities click moves scrollY 0 -> 2437). Accordion expands with subgroups; 4 groups present (spiritual/values/service/tribal). Visit hours card renders 'MONDAY — SUNDAY', '6:00 AM — 12:00 Noon', '5:00 PM — 8:00 PM'. Google Maps iframe src verified. Ashrama carousel prev/next buttons clickable. Admin: login OK, new Activities tab present, subgroups textarea + Save writes to backend (verified via /api/activities GET), 'Activity updated' toast appears. Gallery tab shows category dropdown and 7 category filter buttons (all/gallery/ashrama/spiritual/values/service/tribal). Regression: events CRUD, contact submit, admin login/logout all still passing.

issues: Footer shows 'Morning Darshan 6:00 – 9:00 AM' and 'Evening Aarti 6:30 – 8:00 PM' which does NOT match the Visit Us card hours (6:00 AM — 12:00 Noon and 5:00 PM — 8:00 PM). Inconsistent hours between footer and Visit Us section — likely a content bug.

action_items: Reconcile darshan hours in Footer (SACRED HOURS block) with Visit Us hours card — they show different times.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: PUT /api/activities/{key} accepts subgroups=[] and strips empty strings — behavior is fine but consider validating min length or restricting key to known set for defense in depth.
Gallery upload has no server-side file-size or content-type allowlist enforcement (still open from iter 1).
Activities endpoint does not paginate/limit list (fine while N=4).
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 4 activity groups (spiritual, values, service, tribal) and 2 sample events on startup — verified. Test 'service' subgroups were mutated + restored during test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new iteration-2 features working end-to-end. Only design/content issue: Footer sacred-hours differ from Visit Us section — needs main agent to decide canonical times. Razorpay/Resend still unconfigured (expected). Admin dashboard renders at /admin route (not /admin/dashboard).
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs. Minor content inconsistency between Footer and Visit Us hours flagged for main agent review.
